description.value: Kokoro Tokyo Mazesoba is a Japanese fast-casual chain specializing in mazesoba, a brothless sauced noodle dish that originated in Tokyo and has grown into an international franchise. The downtown Vancouver location seats 75 guests and offers a broad menu of mazesoba styles from classic to spicy, alongside ramen, with customizable toppings and the signature free 'oi-meshi' rice add-on. It is one of three Lower Mainland locations and serves as a substantial refuelling option in the heart of the city core.
